name: URL Summary Workflow
description: Fetches a web page from a given URL, extracts and cleans its text content, then produces a one-page summary highlighting key points and open questions.

agents.description: Fetches the page at the given URL and extracts clean, readable text content, stripping HTML markup, navigation, ads, and other boilerplate.
Reads the cleaned page text and writes a one-page summary that includes key points and a list of open questions raised by the content.
